name: notice
description: An inline notice: offline, guest, allowance, or the outcome of something the user just did. One short paragraph in the product's voice. Never touches history.

announce.description: Reports something that just happened, so assistive technology announces it (role="status"). Leave off for a notice that is part of the page from the start.

text.description: One or two sentences of final copy. Plain text: no links or emphasis.

action.description: A control that acts on what the notice says, after its text on the same line (05-reflection: Change that).

exposes.--aj-c-notice-padding: Inner padding. Default var(--s5) var(--s6); the auth screens set var(--s6).

states.focus-visible: n/a: not interactive and never focusable
states.loading: n/a: a notice reports a state
states.error: n/a: failures are stated in words, never colour-coded (direction-lock rule 2.4)
states.empty: n/a: a notice with nothing to say is not rendered

a11y.role: status when announce is set; otherwise none
a11y.labels: the text is the content; no label needed

changelog.change: Converted from lock.css F1 .notice. Margins stay with the parents; the auth screens' larger padding is the exposed --aj-c-notice-padding.
Slot action: a control after the text, on the same line (the page modules render the screens' notices with their buttons).
The loading state no longer points at F4 progress, which is removed.
